leftEvidence.title: Jesus comes to John and speaks of fulfilling righteousness

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus comes from Galilee to be baptized; John resists, Jesus answers, and the baptism proceeds.
points.right: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John; Moses and Elijah appear, and a bright cloud overshadows them.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Opened heavens, descending Spirit, and a heavenly voice identify the beloved Son in whom God delights.
points.right: A voice names Jesus as beloved Son, adds divine pleasure, and commands the disciples to listen to him.

payload.posture: Matthew repeats beloved-Son and divine-pleasure language in two major scenes.

rightEvidence.title: The beloved-Son voice is heard on the mountain

payload.tension: The mountain adds visible disciples, Moses, Elijah, cloud, transformation, and a command to listen.
payload.title: The beloved-Son voice at river and mountain
